title: Bring an answering word toward the call

source.projectProvenanceNote: Current project manifest recorded at curation; it is not asserted to be the exact frozen render revision.

motion.summary: Call appears at the left while an empty copper circle marks a receiving space at the right. The supporting phrase and I will builds below their shared line. ANSWER appears at the right as the circle clears, and the two main words move closer together before the next scene.
phases: 258.2–259.2s: establish Call opposite a vacant receiving circle while the supporting words arrive below.
259.4s: reveal ANSWER in the receiving region, retaining Call and the complete connecting phrase.
259.6–260.6s: reduce the distance between the two intact main words, finishing as a compact pair.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Give a call and its response separate spatial stations, then reduce their distance after the response is present so connection is demonstrated by the relationship between words.
variations: Let two speakers begin on opposite sides of a shared reading space, then bring their complete statements toward a common baseline after acknowledgment.
For a reassurance lyric, keep the question near the edge and let the answer draw both words into a calm central composition.
For a reunion lyric, replace the empty receiver with a meaningful location from the current story and converge the intact names only after both have been read.
cautions: The important idea is the changing relationship between two words, not the decorative receiver circle; use a fresh spatial metaphor.
Do not fuse, overlap or obscure the two words when their distance closes.
The source places and I will below both main words, which can complicate reading order in a still; make the temporal reading path unambiguous in a new adaptation.
Keep the response entrance tied to verified lyric timing; these images alone do not establish correct sung sync.

quality.reviewer: Rook curation agent; decoded v4 samples at 0.2-second intervals and selected native frames, 2026-09-28
quality.userPreferenceScope: No individual approval of this treatment is recorded. Existing likes of standalone dust clips do not transfer to it. Earlier opening/keyhole and late-segment concerns are not certified resolved by this review.
strengths: The empty receiving region makes a later response visually expected.
The two main words remain intact and visibly distinct as the gap between them decreases.
A short interval supports a complete relationship change without a complex photographic asset.
limitations: The receiver is a generic circle and the finished layout is simple; copying the shapes would produce a familiar title treatment.
The connecting phrase sits below the main pair rather than in normal sentence order.
Inspected 0.2-second decoded samples and selected native frames; six retained frames do not certify every frame, full-speed smoothness, pacing, audio sync or full-film acceptance.

curation.novelty: The retained principle is two-way spatial convergence after the response arrives. The initial empty emblem alone is already covered by internal-fingerprint-mark and is not the reason to add this card.
